input.quote: 24.1 Customer may assign this Agreement or an Order Form without Vendor's consent to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition, or sale of all or substantially all assets or business to which the Agreement relates.
input.rationale: Section 24 meets the preferred position. § 24.1 lets Customer assign to an Affiliate or to a successor in a merger, reorganization, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without Vendor's consent (notice only). § 24.2 bars Vendor assignment, delegation of material performance, or transfer by change of control without Customer's prior written consent, with the reasonableness standard running in Customer's favour, and bars assignment to a direct Customer competitor. § 24.4 expressly denies Vendor any termination, suspension, repricing, acceleration or service-reduction right on Customer's change of control, so the walk-away trigger is absent. § 13.3 reinforces Customer's licence-transfer right. Only minor wording points fall short of ideal drafting — the competitor bar is qualified by "without Customer's consent" (immaterial, since no Vendor assignment is permitted without our consent at all) and the § 24.2 reasonableness standard omits "conditioned or delayed" (supplied for other assignments in § 24.3). These are noted, not redlined.
